speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
text: If the MP were eventually found guilty, it would have been a waste of taxpayers' money and a drain on our resources.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The question is, "That leave be given to introduce a Bill intituled 'An Act to amend the Parliament (Privileges, Immunities and Powers) Act 1962'." As many as are of that opinion say "Aye".
